sections.heading: Pratham Khand - “Main Sharir-Mann Hoon” Ki Mool Bhool
blocks: Ab tak ki yatra me sadhak ne teen bade kadam rakhe hain. Pehle adhyay me usne apne andar dekha: sharir ko, mann ko, anubhavkarta ko, aur us shaant jaanne wali upasthiti ko jise is course me sakshi kaha gaya. Doosre adhyay me usne maya aur jagat ko samjha: jagat anubhav me aata hai, vyavahar me mahatvapurn hai, lekin antim satya nahi hai. Teesre adhyay me usne seekha ki sakshi-bhav ko sirf dhyan me nahi, balki rishte, kaam, safalta-asafalta aur gehri bhavnaon ke beech bhi yaad rakha ja sakta hai.
Ab chautha adhyay us gaanth ki taraf jaata hai jo is poori bhool ko baandh kar rakhti hai. Ye gaanth hai - ahankar.

Ahankar shabd sunte hi kai log sochte hain ki iska matlab sirf ghamand hai. Jaise koi apne aap ko bada samjhe, doosron ko chhota samjhe, prashansa chahe - bas wahi ahankar hai. Ye ahankar ka ek roop ho sakta hai, lekin is course me ahankar ka arth isse bahut gehra hai.

Yahan ahankar ka arth hai - vah “main” ki dharna jo sharir, mann, vichar, naam, kahani aur bhumika ko apna sachcha swaroop maan leti hai. Seedhi bhasha me: ahankar vah mool bhool hai jisme sadhak kehta hai - “main ye sharir-mann hoon.” Isi bhool se anubhavkarta paida hota hai. Wahi kehta hai: “mere saath aisa hua”, “main dukhi hoon”, “main safal hoon”, “main asafal hoon”, “mujhe gyaan hua.” Ab hume is “main” ko bahut dhairya se dekhna hai.

Sabse pehle ek confusion saaf kar lete hain. Ahankar sirf ye nahi kehta: “main sabse bada hoon.” Ahankar ye bhi keh sakta hai: “main bahut chhota hoon.” “Main sabse shreshth hoon” bhi ahankar hai. “Main kisi laayak nahi hoon” bhi ahankar ho sakta hai. Dono me center wahi hai - “meri kahani.” Kabhi ye “main” bada banna chahta hai. Kabhi ye chhota ban kar dukh me baith jata hai. Kabhi ye samman chahta hai. Kabhi apmaan ki kahani pakde rakhta hai.

Ahankar ki sabse sthool pakad sharir se judti hai. “Main sundar hoon”, “main asundar hoon”, “main jawan hoon”, “main boodha hoon”, “main swasth hoon”, “main beemar hoon.” Vyavahar me sharir ka dhyan rakhna zaroori hai. Sharir beemar ho to upchar chahiye. Sharir thaka ho to vishram chahiye. Sharir ki upeक्षा sadhana nahi hai. Lekin sharir ki sthiti ko apna poora “main” maan lena ahankar ki shuruaat hai. Sharir badalta hai. Sakshi in badlavon ko jaanta hai. Ahankar kehta hai - “main wahi badlav hoon.”

Sharir ke baad ahankar ki doosri pakad mann se judti hai. “Mere vichar hi main hoon”, “meri bhavna hi main hoon”, “meri pasand hi main hoon”, “meri rai hi main hoon”, “meri yaadein hi main hoon.” Mann me vichar uthte hain, bhavnaen uthti hain, yaadein aati hain, kalpana chalti hai. Humne pehle dekha hai ki mann badalne wala pravah hai. Lekin ahankar is pravah ko pakad kar kehta hai - “yehi main hoon.”

Koi hamari rai se asahmat ho jaye to ahankar ko chot lagti hai, kyunki usne rai ko “main” bana liya. Koi hamari ichchha poori na kare to ahankar dukhi ho jata hai, kyunki usne ichchha ko “main” ka extension bana liya. Mann ka vichar rakhna problem nahi hai. Problem tab hoti hai jab mann ki har gati par ahankar stamp laga deta hai: “ye main hoon.” Vichar uthna mann ka kaam hai. Vichar se pehchan banana ahankar ka kaam hai.

Ab anubhavkarta kaise banta hai, ye samajhna aasaan ho jata hai. Sakshi sirf jaanta hai. Sharir ki sthiti jaanta hai. Mann ki gati jaanta hai. Vichar, bhav, sukh, dukh - sabko jaanta hai. Lekin jab pehchan sharir-mann se jud jaati hai, tab anubhavkarta uthta hai. Dukh aaya. Sakshi jaanta hai - “dukh ka anubhav ho raha hai.” Ahankar kehta hai - “main dukhi hoon.” Yahin anubhavkarta ban gaya.

Isliye ahankar aur anubhavkarta bahut nazdeek jude hain. Ahankar mool galat pehchan hai - “main sharir-mann hoon.” Anubhavkarta usi pehchan se uthne wala vyaktigat “main” hai jo anubhavon ko apna maanta hai. Sakshi in dono ko jaan sakta hai. Is baat ko bahut dhyan se rakho: ahankar ko turant maarna nahi hai. Anubhavkarta koi dushman nahi hai. Pehle inhe dekhna hai. Jo clearly dekha jata hai, uski pakad dheere-dheere dhili hoti hai.

Ek actor ka example lo. Actor stage par raja ka role kar raha hai. Mukut pehna hai, singhasan par baitha hai, log pranam kar rahe hain. Natak me role useful hai. Problem tab hogi jab natak khatam hone ke baad bhi actor khud ko sach-much raja maan le. Role useful tha, par asli identity nahi tha. Life me bhi aisa hi hai. Tum pita, mata, teacher, trader, sadhak, guru, shishya kuch bhi ho sakte ho. Roles vyavahar me zaroori hain. Lekin role ko final swaroop maan lena ahankar hai. Role nibhao, role ban mat jao.

Ahankar naam aur kahani se bhi banta hai. Har vyakti ke paas apni kahani hoti hai: “mere saath aisa hua”, “maine bahut sangharsh kiya”, “mujhe kabhi samman nahi mila”, “logon ne mujhe samjha nahi.” In kahaniyon me kai baatein sach ho sakti hain. Lekin sadhana ka prashn hai: kya main sirf apni kahani hoon? Kahani memory me hai. Memory mann me aati-jaati hai. Sakshi kahani ko bhi jaan sakta hai. Kahani life ka description ho sakti hai; tumhara antim swaroop nahi.

Jab sadhak apne andar ahankar dekhna shuru karta hai to kabhi-kabhi ghabra jata hai. Sochta hai: “Mere andar itna ahankar hai. Main achcha sadhak nahi hoon.” Ye bhi ek subtle trap hai. Ahankar ko dekh kar khud ko blame karna bhi ahankar ki ek aur chaal ho sakti hai. Isliye yahan bahut komalta chahiye. Ahankar ko dekhna hai, usse nafrat nahi karni. Pehchanna hai, ladna nahi. Samajhna hai, dabana nahi.

Agar ahankar keh raha hai “main sharir-mann hoon”, to is baat ko jaane wala kaun hai? Agar ahankar keh raha hai “mujhe samman chahiye”, to ye ichchha kis me jaani ja rahi hai? Yahin se sakshi-bhav ki disha khulti hai. Sakshi ahankar se ladta nahi. Sakshi ahankar ko jaanta hai. Jaise deepak kamre ki cheezon ko prakashit karta hai, waise hi sakshi-bhav me ahankar ki paratein dikhne lagti hain.

Is pratham khand me humne ahankar ki mool pehchan ko samjha. Ahankar sirf ghamand nahi hai. Ye vah “main” ki dharna hai jo sharir, mann, naam, role aur kahani ko apna sachcha swaroop maan leti hai. Ab aage hum role, image aur story wale ahankar ko aur clearly dekhenge. Abhi ke liye itna yaad rakho: ahankar ko dushman mat banao. Use chhupao mat. Use dekh kar blame mat karo. Bas pehchano.
#### Aaj Ke Liye Abhyas

Aaj din me ek pal pakdo jahan “main” bahut strong ho gaya. Kisi ne tumhari baat nahi maani, kisi ne praise kiya, kisi ne criticism kiya, ya tumhe laga ki tumhe samman milna chahiye tha. Phir poochho: us waqt “main” kis se pehchan bana raha tha - sharir, vichar, role, result ya kahani? Is “main” ko kya chahiye tha - samman, security, right prove hona, prem, control ya recognition? Kya main is uthte hue “main” ko dekh sakta hoon? Bas dekho. Ahankar ko dekhna hi ahankar se pehli doori hai.

sections.heading: Dwitiya Khand - Role, Image Aur Kahani Ka Ahankar
blocks: Pichhle khand me humne ahankar ki mool gaanth dekhi. Ab hum uski kuch clear paratein dekhenge. Ye paratein har vyakti me kisi na kisi roop me hoti hain. Inhe dekh kar darna nahi hai, bas dekhna hai ki “main” kahan chipak raha hai. Is khand me teen paratein hain: role ka ahankar, image ka ahankar aur kahani ka ahankar.

Life me har vyakti kai roles nibhata hai - pita, mata, beta, beti, pati, patni, friend, teacher, trader, sadhak, guru, shishya. Role problem nahi hai. Role life ke vyavahar ke liye zaroori hai. Problem role ko “main” bana lene me hai. Koi kahe “main pita hoon”, vyavahar me theek hai. Lekin andar se bhav ho: “kyunki main pita hoon, meri baat hi final honi chahiye”, to role ahankar ban gaya.

Role kapde jaisa hai. Use pehenna hai, nibhana hai, par apna sharir nahi samajhna. Jaise koi kaam par uniform pehenta hai aur ghar aakar utaar deta hai. Uniform useful tha, identity nahi tha. Life ke roles bhi aise hi hain. Sakshi-bhav me sadhak dekh sakta hai: “abhi pita ka role bol raha hai”, “abhi teacher ka role active hai”, “abhi sadhak wali identity bach rahi hai.” Ye dekhna role ko weak nahi karta, balki clean karta hai.

Role nibhana aur role ban jaana alag baat hai. Maa bachche ka dhyan rakhe - ye role nibhana hai. Maa ye maan le ki bachche ka har decision uske control me hona chahiye - ye role ban jaana hai. Teacher guide kare - ye role nibhana hai. Teacher kisi disagreement ko bardasht na kar paaye - ye role ban jaana hai. Role nibhana responsibility hai. Role ban jaana pakad hai.

Doosri parat hai image ka ahankar. Image ka matlab hai - main doosron ki nazar me kaisa dikhta hoon. Insaan sirf jeena nahi chahta, achcha dikhna bhi chahta hai. Chahta hai log use samajhdar, successful, spiritual, sensitive, strong, special manein. Kai baar hum koi kaam isliye karte hain ki sach hai, aisa nahi; balki isliye karte hain ki image achchi dikhe. Kai baar galti accept nahi karte kyunki image tootne ka darr hota hai.

Image ka ahankar subtle hai. Wo sirf praise nahi chahta, criticism se bhi bachna chahta hai. Jab koi image ke against kuch keh de to andar bechaini uthti hai: “log kya sochenge?”, “meri izzat chali jayegi”, “meri spiritual image toot jayegi.” Yahan sadhak ko honest hona hoga. Main sach se kar raha hoon ya image bachane se? Main chup hoon kyunki silence theek hai, ya criticism ka darr hai? Main vinamr hoon ya vinamr dikhna chahta hoon?

Aaj ke samay me image aur bhi subtle ho gayi hai. Photos, posts, videos, public identity - har jagah image banti hai. Sadhak bhi isse free nahi hai. Spiritual image ban sakti hai - shaant, gehra, gyani, alag, awakened, loving. Phir sadhak us image ko perform karne lagta hai. Andar gussa ho to chhupata hai. Darr ho to accept nahi karta. Spiritual image bhi ahankar ki parat ban sakti hai.

Teesri parat hai kahani ka ahankar. Har vyakti apne baare me ek story rakhta hai. Ye story memories, wounds, achievements, relationships aur conclusions se banti hai. “Maine bahut struggle kiya”, “mujhe kabhi prem nahi mila”, “maine sab khud banaya”, “log mujhe chhod dete hain.” In stories me events sach ho sakte hain. Lekin question hai: kya main wahi story hoon?

Story mann me hai. Memory se banti hai. Memory aati-jaati aur badalti hai. Ek hi event ka meaning life ke alag phases me badal sakta hai. Lekin ahankar story ko fixed identity bana leta hai: “mere saath aisa hua, isliye main aisa hoon.” Sakshi-bhav story ko mitata nahi, dekhta hai. Jaise hi story dekhi jaati hai, ek doori khulti hai: shayad main story se bada hoon.

Story-ego ki ek subtle parat hai victim identity. Kabhi insaan apne dukh se itna jud jata hai ki dukh identity ban jata hai. Dukh ka samman zaroori hai. Chot hui hai to use dekhna hoga. Lekin dukh ko permanent identity bana lena bandhan hai. Har nayi baat purani chot se dekhi jaati hai. Sakshi-bhav dheere se dekhta hai: “dukh hai, purani chot hai, mann khud ko victim maan raha hai.”

Story-ego ki doosri parat hai special hone ki identity. “Main alag hoon”, “mujhe koi samajh nahi sakta”, “mere experiences bahut gehre hain”, “meri sadhana alag hai.” Kabhi ye spiritual roop le leti hai: “maine kuch dekh liya hai jo doosron ne nahi dekha.” Ye bhi ahankar hai. Ahankar kabhi bada ban kar aata hai, kabhi dukhi, kabhi special, kabhi alag. Root me wahi grip hai - “main ye hoon.”

In paraton ko kaise dekhein? Jab apni baat manwane ki strong ichchha ho, poochho: ye clarity hai ya role ka ahankar? Jab criticism sun kar bechaini ho, poochho: mujhe sach ki chinta hai ya image tootne ka darr? Jab purani kahani baar-baar repeat ho, poochho: kya ye story meri identity bani hui hai?

Ahankar ki parat dikhna failure nahi, kripa hai. Jo pehle andhere me chal raha tha, ab dikh raha hai. Jab kamra andhera hota hai, dhool nahi dikhti. Jab light aati hai, dhool dikhti hai. Light ne dhool banayi nahi; bas dikha di. Sakshi-bhav bhi aisi hi light hai.

Is khand me humne role, image aur story ke ahankar ko dekha. Agle khand me hum spiritual ahankar dekhenge - wo ahankar jo sadhana, gyaan, experience, seva, vinamrata aur “main jag gaya hoon” ke peeche bhi chhup sakta hai. Abhi ke liye yaad rakho: role nibhao, role mat bano. Image ka dhyan rakho, image me kaid mat ho. Story samjho, story ko final swaroop mat banao.
#### Aaj Ke Liye Abhyas

Aaj ek pal dekho jahan tumhe role, image ya story bachane ki ichchha uthti dikhi. Poochho: kaunsa role active tha? Kya main sach se bol raha tha ya image bacha raha tha? Kya main present event dekh raha tha ya purani story se react kar raha tha? Phir dheere se kaho: “ye role jaana ja raha hai, ye image ki chinta jaani ja rahi hai, ye kahani jaani ja rahi hai. Main inhe dekh sakta hoon.”

sections.heading: Tritiya Khand - Spiritual Ahankar Ki Sukshm Parat
blocks: Pichhle khand me humne role, image aur story ke ahankar ko dekha. Ab hum ek aur gehri, bahut subtle parat par aate hain. Ye parat hamesha pride, gussa ya control ki bhasha me nahi aati. Kabhi ye shanti ki bhasha me aati hai, kabhi vinamrata ki bhasha me, kabhi gyaan, dhyan, seva aur spiritual experience ki bhasha me. Isliye ise pehchanna mushkil hota hai. Isko hum kahenge - spiritual ahankar.

Spiritual ahankar ka matlab hai - jab wahi purana “main” spiritual words, experiences, roles aur achievements ko pakad kar nayi identity bana leta hai. Pehle kehta tha “main successful hoon”, ab kehta hai “main aware hoon.” Pehle kehta tha “main doosron se better hoon”, ab kehta hai “main doosron se zyada spiritual hoon.” Words badal gaye, andar “main” ki grip wahi reh sakti hai.

Sadhana ka purpose identity ko halka karna hai. Lekin savdhani na ho to sadhana bhi nayi identity ban sakti hai. Sadhak dhyan karta hai, shanti milti hai - sundar hai. Granth padhta hai, samajh badhti hai - useful hai. Seva karta hai, hriday komal hota hai - shubh hai. Lekin ahankar aa sakta hai: “main regular dhyan karta hoon, isliye main better hoon”, “mujhe gehre experiences hue hain”, “main ab normal logon jaisa nahi hoon.” Yahan sadhana identity ban gayi.

Spiritual path par experiences aate hain. Kabhi dhyan me shanti, kabhi sharir halka, kabhi vichar kam, kabhi anand. Inhe deny nahi karna. Lekin pakadna bhi nahi. Anubhavkarta keh sakta hai: “mujhe sakshi ka experience hua”, “mujhe advaita experience hua”, “ab mujhe samajh aa gaya.” Jo experience aaya aur gaya, wo experience hai. Sakshi wo hai jo us experience ko bhi jaanta hai. Experiences ka samman karo, par unhe final truth mat banao.

Spiritual ahankar ka ek subtle roop hai vinamrata ka ahankar. Sadhak kehta hai: “main to kuch bhi nahi hoon”, par andar chahta hai log kahe: “dekho, kitne vinamr hain.” Kehta hai: “mujhe samman nahi chahiye”, par samman na mile to chot lagti hai. Vinamrata sundar hai. Vinamr dikhne ki ichchha ahankar hai. Seva sundar hai. Seva se identity banana ahankar hai. Shanti sundar hai. Peaceful person ki image banana ahankar hai.

Ahankar gyaan ko bhi pakad sakta hai. Sadhak ne words samjhe - sakshi, atma, brahm, maya, ahankar, avidya, moksha. Samajh badhi. Ye achcha hai. Lekin mann keh sakta hai: “main jaanta hoon”, “doosre nahi jaante”, “meri vyakhya shreshth hai”, “mujhe koi sikhane ki zaroorat nahi.” Ye gyaan nahi, gyaan ka ahankar hai. Sacha gyaan vyakti ko zyada open banata hai, closed nahi; zyada komal, hard nahi; zyada sunne yogya, sirf bolne wala nahi.

Sabse subtle layer ho sakti hai - “main jag gaya hoon.” Sachchi jagrukta me “main” ki pakad dhili hoti hai. Par spiritual ahankar jagrukta ko bhi achievement bana sakta hai. Kehta hai: “main awake hoon, baaki soye hue hain.” Yahan purana bhed aa gaya - main upar, doosre neeche. Sadhak ko poochhna hoga: meri samajh se karuna badhi hai ya superiority? Main simple hua hoon ya special?

Seva aur tyag bhi spiritual life ke sundar parts hain. Lekin ahankar inhe bhi pakad sakta hai. Koi seva kare aur andar bhav ho: “mere bina ye nahi ho sakta”, to ahankar aa gaya. Koi tyag kare aur andar bhav ho: “dekho, main kitna tyagi hoon”, to tyag identity ban gaya. Seva rokni nahi hai. Tyag ko reject nahi karna hai. Bas unke andar chhupe “main” ko dekhna hai.

Jab sadhak apne andar spiritual ahankar dekhta hai, kabhi shame aati hai. Sochta hai: “main sadhana kar raha tha, phir bhi ahankar hai, main jhootha hoon.” Dhyan do: spiritual ahankar dikhna failure nahi hai. Wo chhupa rahe, ye zyada dangerous hai. Agar tum dekh pa rahe ho ki spiritual dikhne ki ichchha hai, to ye dekhna hi sakshi-bhav hai. Shame me mat dubo. Blame me mat jao. Bas dekho.

Spiritual ahankar ke vipreet hai sachchi saralta. Saralta ka matlab weakness nahi hai. Iska matlab hai - samajh hai par dikhawa nahi, clarity hai par hardness nahi, experience hai par pakad nahi, seva hai par claim nahi, gyaan hai par superiority nahi. Sacha sadhak jaanta hai ki jo bhi samajh aayi hai, wo kripa hai. Wo bolta hai, par sun bhi sakta hai. Wo path par chalta hai, par doosron ko chhota nahi maanta.

Jab bhi sadhana, gyaan ya experience se judi baat uthe, teen sawal poochho: kya main isse identity bana raha hoon? Kya isme superior hone ka bhav hai? Kya isme recognition, respect ya special dikhne ki ichchha hai? Agar haan aaye, chinta mat karo. Yehi dekhna hai. Phir poochho: ye ichchha kis me jaani ja rahi hai? Ye garv kis me uth raha hai? Kya sakshi isse badal raha hai?

Is khand me humne spiritual ahankar dekha. Sadhana, gyaan, experience, seva, vinamrata aur awareness tak ko ahankar pakad sakta hai. Antim khand me hum dekhenge ki ahankar se ladna nahi, use maarna nahi; use dekhna hai.
#### Aaj Ke Liye Abhyas

Aaj apni sadhana, gyaan, seva ya spiritual identity se juda ek pal dekho. Shayad tumhe laga ki tum zyada samajhte ho, apne experience par garv hua, tumne chaha ki tumhari vinamrata dekhi jaye, ya andar kisi ko “agyani” mana. Poochho: yahan sach ki saralta thi ya special hone ki ichchha? Yahan karuna thi ya superiority? Kya main is spiritual “main” ko bhi dekh sakta hoon? Dekhna hi shuddhi ki shuruaat hai.

sections.heading: Chaturth Khand - Ahankar Ko Maarna Nahi, Dekhna Hai
blocks: Pichhle khand me humne spiritual ahankar ki subtle parat dekhi. Ab ek zaroori baat samajhni hai: ahankar se ladna nahi hai. Ahankar ko maarna nahi hai. Ahankar ko sakshi-bhav me dekhna hai.

Jis ahankar se tum ladoge, wo ladne wale “main” ke roop me phir khada ho jayega. Wo kahega: “main ahankar ko jeet raha hoon”, “main ahankar se mukt ho raha hoon”, “main ab doosron se zyada ego-less hoon.” Aur dekho, ahankar wapas aa gaya. Isliye raasta war ka nahi, seeing ka hai.

Jab sadhak pehli baar apne andar ahankar dekhta hai to ghabra sakta hai: “itni paratein hain, main aage kaise badhunga?” Phir mann decide karta hai: “mujhe ego destroy karna hai.” Savdhani chahiye. Agar ego destroy karne ki ichchha bhi ek hard “main” se uth rahi hai, to wo bhi ahankar ban sakti hai. Sadhana me honesty hai, violence nahi. Clarity hai, self-punishment nahi.

Ahankar ko dekhna simple hai. Jab andar koi kahe “mujhe samman chahiye”, use dekho. Jab kahe “main sahi hoon, doosra galat hai”, use dekho. Jab kahe “meri image bachni chahiye”, use dekho. Jab kahe “main bahut spiritual hoon”, use bhi dekho. Dekhna ka matlab turant fix karna nahi. Dekhna ka matlab bas itna: “ye ‘main’ ki ek parat uth rahi hai. Ye jaani ja rahi hai.”

Life me ek practical “main” zaroori rahega. Koi naam puchega, tum jawab doge. Koi kaam karna hoga, kahoge “main karunga.” Sharir ko bhojan chahiye, kahoge “mujhe bhookh hai.” Is practical “main” me problem nahi. Problem tab hoti hai jab practical “main” final truth ban jata hai. Vyavahar me “main” bolo, par andar jaano ki ye role aur function ki bhasha hai.

Ahankar ki paratein ek din me nahi bani; ek din me dhili bhi nahi hongi. Sharir se pehchan bachpan se bani. Naam aur role society ne diye. Image doosron ki nazar se bani. Story memory se bani. Spiritual identity path me bhi ban sakti hai. Inhe dhairya se dekhna hoga. Ahankar ki paratein teen baaton se dhili hoti hain: pehchanna, sweekar karna, aur sakshi-bhav me lautna.

Ek mirror ka example lo. Darpan par dhool jam gayi hai. Reflection clear nahi dikh raha. Agar koi kahe darpan kharab hai, baat poori nahi. Darpan reflect kar sakta hai; dhool upar jam gayi hai. Dhool se ladna nahi, darpan todna nahi. Dhool ko dekhna hai, dheere saaf karna hai. Ahankar ki paratein dhool jaisi hain. Wo mool satya ko cover kar sakti hain, destroy nahi kar sakti.

Jab ahankar ki pakad dhili hoti hai, rishte badalne lagte hain. Pehle chot jaldi lagti thi; ab chot uthti hai par dekhi ja sakti hai. Pehle disagreement apmaan lagta tha; ab suna ja sakta hai. Pehle prem me pakad thi; ab prem me thodi jagah aati hai. Ahankar rishte ko apni security ka tool banana chahta hai. Sakshi-bhav rishte ko zyada sachcha banata hai.

Kaam me bhi ahankar dhila ho to karm clear hota hai. Pehle kaam result se identity banata tha. Ab kaam learning aur seva ka field ban sakta hai. Pehle success se “main bada” hota tha. Ab success gratitude la sakti hai. Pehle failure se “main chhota” hota tha. Ab failure learning ka gate ban sakti hai. Identity halki hoti hai to karm weak nahi hota; karm clean hota hai.

Sadhana me ahankar sabse subtle ho sakta hai. Dhyan me shanti aaye, use jaano. Shanti na aaye, use bhi jaano. Deep experience aaye, jaano. Experience na aaye, jaano. Garv uthe: “main achcha sadhak hoon”, use jaano. Heenata uthe: “main sadhana nahi kar pa raha”, use bhi jaano. Sadhana ka goal experiences collect karna nahi hai. Goal hai har experience ke beech apne ko jaana.

Ab is adhyay ki yatra sametein. Pratham khand me humne mool gaanth dekhi - “main sharir-mann hoon.” Dwitiya khand me role, image aur story ka ahankar dekha. Tritiya khand me spiritual ahankar dekha. Is antim khand me dekha ki ahankar se ladna nahi, use maarna nahi; use sakshi-bhav me dekhna hai. Jo clearly dekha jata hai, uski pakad dheere-dheere dhili hoti hai.

Ab sadhak agle kadam ke liye taiyar hai. Ab tak dekha: main sirf sharir nahi, sirf mann nahi, sirf anubhavkarta nahi, sirf role, image, kahani ya spiritual experience nahi. Agla adhyay hai - Neti-Neti. Neti-Neti ka saral arth hai - “ye nahi, ye nahi.” Ye negative hona nahi hai. Iska arth hai: jo main nahi hoon, use clarity se pehchanna, taki jo main hoon wo apne aap clear hone lage.

Ahankar ki paratein dekhna kabhi difficult lag sakta hai, lekin sahi bhav se dekha jaye to ye bahut halka karta hai. Har role ko final identity nahi banana. Har criticism se tootna nahi. Har praise me phoolna nahi. Har story ko pakad kar nahi baithna. Har spiritual experience ko achievement nahi banana. Bas dekhna hai. Jaise-jaise dekhna gehra hota hai, life halki hoti hai.

Jahan bhi “main” strong uthe, ruko aur dekho: ye kaunsa “main” hai? Kis se pehchan bana raha hai? Kya chahta hai? Kya ye bhi jaana ja raha hai? Isi sawal me ahankar ki pakad dhili hone lagti hai. Dheere chalo. Komal raho. Chhupao mat. Blame mat karo. Bas dekho. Dekhna hi mukti ki disha hai.
#### Is Hafte Ke Liye Abhyas

Agle saat din ahankar ki paraton ko bahut komalta se dekho. Jab bhi “main” strong uthe, poochho: abhi kaunsi parat active hai - sharir identity, mann ki rai, role, image, purani story, success-failure, ya spiritual identity? Phir poochho: is “main” ko abhi kya chahiye - samman, security, control, prem, recognition, right prove hona, ya special dikhna? Phir teesra sawal: kya main is “main” ko dekh sakta hoon? Agar dekh pa rahe ho, kaho: “ye ahankar ki parat uth rahi hai. Ye jaani ja rahi hai. Main ise dekh sakta hoon.” Ise self-blame mat banao. Ise inner cleaning ka komal abhyas banao.

# Nirvan Sutra
## Adhyay 4: Ahankar Ki Paratein

### Pratham Khand - “Main Sharir-Mann Hoon” Ki Mool Bhool

Ab tak ki yatra me sadhak ne teen bade kadam rakhe hain. Pehle adhyay me usne apne andar dekha: sharir ko, mann ko, anubhavkarta ko, aur us shaant jaanne wali upasthiti ko jise is course me sakshi kaha gaya. Doosre adhyay me usne maya aur jagat ko samjha: jagat anubhav me aata hai, vyavahar me mahatvapurn hai, lekin antim satya nahi hai. Teesre adhyay me usne seekha ki sakshi-bhav ko sirf dhyan me nahi, balki rishte, kaam, safalta-asafalta aur gehri bhavnaon ke beech bhi yaad rakha ja sakta hai.

Ab chautha adhyay us gaanth ki taraf jaata hai jo is poori bhool ko baandh kar rakhti hai. Ye gaanth hai - ahankar.

Ahankar shabd sunte hi kai log sochte hain ki iska matlab sirf ghamand hai. Jaise koi apne aap ko bada samjhe, doosron ko chhota samjhe, prashansa chahe - bas wahi ahankar hai. Ye ahankar ka ek roop ho sakta hai, lekin is course me ahankar ka arth isse bahut gehra hai.

Yahan ahankar ka arth hai - vah “main” ki dharna jo sharir, mann, vichar, naam, kahani aur bhumika ko apna sachcha swaroop maan leti hai. Seedhi bhasha me: ahankar vah mool bhool hai jisme sadhak kehta hai - “main ye sharir-mann hoon.” Isi bhool se anubhavkarta paida hota hai. Wahi kehta hai: “mere saath aisa hua”, “main dukhi hoon”, “main safal hoon”, “main asafal hoon”, “mujhe gyaan hua.” Ab hume is “main” ko bahut dhairya se dekhna hai.

Sabse pehle ek confusion saaf kar lete hain. Ahankar sirf ye nahi kehta: “main sabse bada hoon.” Ahankar ye bhi keh sakta hai: “main bahut chhota hoon.” “Main sabse shreshth hoon” bhi ahankar hai. “Main kisi laayak nahi hoon” bhi ahankar ho sakta hai. Dono me center wahi hai - “meri kahani.” Kabhi ye “main” bada banna chahta hai. Kabhi ye chhota ban kar dukh me baith jata hai. Kabhi ye samman chahta hai. Kabhi apmaan ki kahani pakde rakhta hai.

Ahankar ki sabse sthool pakad sharir se judti hai. “Main sundar hoon”, “main asundar hoon”, “main jawan hoon”, “main boodha hoon”, “main swasth hoon”, “main beemar hoon.” Vyavahar me sharir ka dhyan rakhna zaroori hai. Sharir beemar ho to upchar chahiye. Sharir thaka ho to vishram chahiye. Sharir ki upeक्षा sadhana nahi hai. Lekin sharir ki sthiti ko apna poora “main” maan lena ahankar ki shuruaat hai. Sharir badalta hai. Sakshi in badlavon ko jaanta hai. Ahankar kehta hai - “main wahi badlav hoon.”

Sharir ke baad ahankar ki doosri pakad mann se judti hai. “Mere vichar hi main hoon”, “meri bhavna hi main hoon”, “meri pasand hi main hoon”, “meri rai hi main hoon”, “meri yaadein hi main hoon.” Mann me vichar uthte hain, bhavnaen uthti hain, yaadein aati hain, kalpana chalti hai. Humne pehle dekha hai ki mann badalne wala pravah hai. Lekin ahankar is pravah ko pakad kar kehta hai - “yehi main hoon.”

Koi hamari rai se asahmat ho jaye to ahankar ko chot lagti hai, kyunki usne rai ko “main” bana liya. Koi hamari ichchha poori na kare to ahankar dukhi ho jata hai, kyunki usne ichchha ko “main” ka extension bana liya. Mann ka vichar rakhna problem nahi hai. Problem tab hoti hai jab mann ki har gati par ahankar stamp laga deta hai: “ye main hoon.” Vichar uthna mann ka kaam hai. Vichar se pehchan banana ahankar ka kaam hai.

Ab anubhavkarta kaise banta hai, ye samajhna aasaan ho jata hai. Sakshi sirf jaanta hai. Sharir ki sthiti jaanta hai. Mann ki gati jaanta hai. Vichar, bhav, sukh, dukh - sabko jaanta hai. Lekin jab pehchan sharir-mann se jud jaati hai, tab anubhavkarta uthta hai. Dukh aaya. Sakshi jaanta hai - “dukh ka anubhav ho raha hai.” Ahankar kehta hai - “main dukhi hoon.” Yahin anubhavkarta ban gaya.

Isliye ahankar aur anubhavkarta bahut nazdeek jude hain. Ahankar mool galat pehchan hai - “main sharir-mann hoon.” Anubhavkarta usi pehchan se uthne wala vyaktigat “main” hai jo anubhavon ko apna maanta hai. Sakshi in dono ko jaan sakta hai. Is baat ko bahut dhyan se rakho: ahankar ko turant maarna nahi hai. Anubhavkarta koi dushman nahi hai. Pehle inhe dekhna hai. Jo clearly dekha jata hai, uski pakad dheere-dheere dhili hoti hai.

Ek actor ka example lo. Actor stage par raja ka role kar raha hai. Mukut pehna hai, singhasan par baitha hai, log pranam kar rahe hain. Natak me role useful hai. Problem tab hogi jab natak khatam hone ke baad bhi actor khud ko sach-much raja maan le. Role useful tha, par asli identity nahi tha. Life me bhi aisa hi hai. Tum pita, mata, teacher, trader, sadhak, guru, shishya kuch bhi ho sakte ho. Roles vyavahar me zaroori hain. Lekin role ko final swaroop maan lena ahankar hai. Role nibhao, role ban mat jao.

Ahankar naam aur kahani se bhi banta hai. Har vyakti ke paas apni kahani hoti hai: “mere saath aisa hua”, “maine bahut sangharsh kiya”, “mujhe kabhi samman nahi mila”, “logon ne mujhe samjha nahi.” In kahaniyon me kai baatein sach ho sakti hain. Lekin sadhana ka prashn hai: kya main sirf apni kahani hoon? Kahani memory me hai. Memory mann me aati-jaati hai. Sakshi kahani ko bhi jaan sakta hai. Kahani life ka description ho sakti hai; tumhara antim swaroop nahi.

Jab sadhak apne andar ahankar dekhna shuru karta hai to kabhi-kabhi ghabra jata hai. Sochta hai: “Mere andar itna ahankar hai. Main achcha sadhak nahi hoon.” Ye bhi ek subtle trap hai. Ahankar ko dekh kar khud ko blame karna bhi ahankar ki ek aur chaal ho sakti hai. Isliye yahan bahut komalta chahiye. Ahankar ko dekhna hai, usse nafrat nahi karni. Pehchanna hai, ladna nahi. Samajhna hai, dabana nahi.

Agar ahankar keh raha hai “main sharir-mann hoon”, to is baat ko jaane wala kaun hai? Agar ahankar keh raha hai “mujhe samman chahiye”, to ye ichchha kis me jaani ja rahi hai? Yahin se sakshi-bhav ki disha khulti hai. Sakshi ahankar se ladta nahi. Sakshi ahankar ko jaanta hai. Jaise deepak kamre ki cheezon ko prakashit karta hai, waise hi sakshi-bhav me ahankar ki paratein dikhne lagti hain.

Is pratham khand me humne ahankar ki mool pehchan ko samjha. Ahankar sirf ghamand nahi hai. Ye vah “main” ki dharna hai jo sharir, mann, naam, role aur kahani ko apna sachcha swaroop maan leti hai. Ab aage hum role, image aur story wale ahankar ko aur clearly dekhenge. Abhi ke liye itna yaad rakho: ahankar ko dushman mat banao. Use chhupao mat. Use dekh kar blame mat karo. Bas pehchano.

#### Aaj Ke Liye Abhyas

Aaj din me ek pal pakdo jahan “main” bahut strong ho gaya. Kisi ne tumhari baat nahi maani, kisi ne praise kiya, kisi ne criticism kiya, ya tumhe laga ki tumhe samman milna chahiye tha. Phir poochho: us waqt “main” kis se pehchan bana raha tha - sharir, vichar, role, result ya kahani? Is “main” ko kya chahiye tha - samman, security, right prove hona, prem, control ya recognition? Kya main is uthte hue “main” ko dekh sakta hoon? Bas dekho. Ahankar ko dekhna hi ahankar se pehli doori hai.

### Dwitiya Khand - Role, Image Aur Kahani Ka Ahankar

Pichhle khand me humne ahankar ki mool gaanth dekhi. Ab hum uski kuch clear paratein dekhenge. Ye paratein har vyakti me kisi na kisi roop me hoti hain. Inhe dekh kar darna nahi hai, bas dekhna hai ki “main” kahan chipak raha hai. Is khand me teen paratein hain: role ka ahankar, image ka ahankar aur kahani ka ahankar.

Life me har vyakti kai roles nibhata hai - pita, mata, beta, beti, pati, patni, friend, teacher, trader, sadhak, guru, shishya. Role problem nahi hai. Role life ke vyavahar ke liye zaroori hai. Problem role ko “main” bana lene me hai. Koi kahe “main pita hoon”, vyavahar me theek hai. Lekin andar se bhav ho: “kyunki main pita hoon, meri baat hi final honi chahiye”, to role ahankar ban gaya.

Role kapde jaisa hai. Use pehenna hai, nibhana hai, par apna sharir nahi samajhna. Jaise koi kaam par uniform pehenta hai aur ghar aakar utaar deta hai. Uniform useful tha, identity nahi tha. Life ke roles bhi aise hi hain. Sakshi-bhav me sadhak dekh sakta hai: “abhi pita ka role bol raha hai”, “abhi teacher ka role active hai”, “abhi sadhak wali identity bach rahi hai.” Ye dekhna role ko weak nahi karta, balki clean karta hai.

Role nibhana aur role ban jaana alag baat hai. Maa bachche ka dhyan rakhe - ye role nibhana hai. Maa ye maan le ki bachche ka har decision uske control me hona chahiye - ye role ban jaana hai. Teacher guide kare - ye role nibhana hai. Teacher kisi disagreement ko bardasht na kar paaye - ye role ban jaana hai. Role nibhana responsibility hai. Role ban jaana pakad hai.

Doosri parat hai image ka ahankar. Image ka matlab hai - main doosron ki nazar me kaisa dikhta hoon. Insaan sirf jeena nahi chahta, achcha dikhna bhi chahta hai. Chahta hai log use samajhdar, successful, spiritual, sensitive, strong, special manein. Kai baar hum koi kaam isliye karte hain ki sach hai, aisa nahi; balki isliye karte hain ki image achchi dikhe. Kai baar galti accept nahi karte kyunki image tootne ka darr hota hai.

Image ka ahankar subtle hai. Wo sirf praise nahi chahta, criticism se bhi bachna chahta hai. Jab koi image ke against kuch keh de to andar bechaini uthti hai: “log kya sochenge?”, “meri izzat chali jayegi”, “meri spiritual image toot jayegi.” Yahan sadhak ko honest hona hoga. Main sach se kar raha hoon ya image bachane se? Main chup hoon kyunki silence theek hai, ya criticism ka darr hai? Main vinamr hoon ya vinamr dikhna chahta hoon?

Aaj ke samay me image aur bhi subtle ho gayi hai. Photos, posts, videos, public identity - har jagah image banti hai. Sadhak bhi isse free nahi hai. Spiritual image ban sakti hai - shaant, gehra, gyani, alag, awakened, loving. Phir sadhak us image ko perform karne lagta hai. Andar gussa ho to chhupata hai. Darr ho to accept nahi karta. Spiritual image bhi ahankar ki parat ban sakti hai.

Teesri parat hai kahani ka ahankar. Har vyakti apne baare me ek story rakhta hai. Ye story memories, wounds, achievements, relationships aur conclusions se banti hai. “Maine bahut struggle kiya”, “mujhe kabhi prem nahi mila”, “maine sab khud banaya”, “log mujhe chhod dete hain.” In stories me events sach ho sakte hain. Lekin question hai: kya main wahi story hoon?

Story mann me hai. Memory se banti hai. Memory aati-jaati aur badalti hai. Ek hi event ka meaning life ke alag phases me badal sakta hai. Lekin ahankar story ko fixed identity bana leta hai: “mere saath aisa hua, isliye main aisa hoon.” Sakshi-bhav story ko mitata nahi, dekhta hai. Jaise hi story dekhi jaati hai, ek doori khulti hai: shayad main story se bada hoon.

Story-ego ki ek subtle parat hai victim identity. Kabhi insaan apne dukh se itna jud jata hai ki dukh identity ban jata hai. Dukh ka samman zaroori hai. Chot hui hai to use dekhna hoga. Lekin dukh ko permanent identity bana lena bandhan hai. Har nayi baat purani chot se dekhi jaati hai. Sakshi-bhav dheere se dekhta hai: “dukh hai, purani chot hai, mann khud ko victim maan raha hai.”

Story-ego ki doosri parat hai special hone ki identity. “Main alag hoon”, “mujhe koi samajh nahi sakta”, “mere experiences bahut gehre hain”, “meri sadhana alag hai.” Kabhi ye spiritual roop le leti hai: “maine kuch dekh liya hai jo doosron ne nahi dekha.” Ye bhi ahankar hai. Ahankar kabhi bada ban kar aata hai, kabhi dukhi, kabhi special, kabhi alag. Root me wahi grip hai - “main ye hoon.”

In paraton ko kaise dekhein? Jab apni baat manwane ki strong ichchha ho, poochho: ye clarity hai ya role ka ahankar? Jab criticism sun kar bechaini ho, poochho: mujhe sach ki chinta hai ya image tootne ka darr? Jab purani kahani baar-baar repeat ho, poochho: kya ye story meri identity bani hui hai?

Ahankar ki parat dikhna failure nahi, kripa hai. Jo pehle andhere me chal raha tha, ab dikh raha hai. Jab kamra andhera hota hai, dhool nahi dikhti. Jab light aati hai, dhool dikhti hai. Light ne dhool banayi nahi; bas dikha di. Sakshi-bhav bhi aisi hi light hai.

Is khand me humne role, image aur story ke ahankar ko dekha. Agle khand me hum spiritual ahankar dekhenge - wo ahankar jo sadhana, gyaan, experience, seva, vinamrata aur “main jag gaya hoon” ke peeche bhi chhup sakta hai. Abhi ke liye yaad rakho: role nibhao, role mat bano. Image ka dhyan rakho, image me kaid mat ho. Story samjho, story ko final swaroop mat banao.

#### Aaj Ke Liye Abhyas

Aaj ek pal dekho jahan tumhe role, image ya story bachane ki ichchha uthti dikhi. Poochho: kaunsa role active tha? Kya main sach se bol raha tha ya image bacha raha tha? Kya main present event dekh raha tha ya purani story se react kar raha tha? Phir dheere se kaho: “ye role jaana ja raha hai, ye image ki chinta jaani ja rahi hai, ye kahani jaani ja rahi hai. Main inhe dekh sakta hoon.”

### Tritiya Khand - Spiritual Ahankar Ki Sukshm Parat

Pichhle khand me humne role, image aur story ke ahankar ko dekha. Ab hum ek aur gehri, bahut subtle parat par aate hain. Ye parat hamesha pride, gussa ya control ki bhasha me nahi aati. Kabhi ye shanti ki bhasha me aati hai, kabhi vinamrata ki bhasha me, kabhi gyaan, dhyan, seva aur spiritual experience ki bhasha me. Isliye ise pehchanna mushkil hota hai. Isko hum kahenge - spiritual ahankar.

Spiritual ahankar ka matlab hai - jab wahi purana “main” spiritual words, experiences, roles aur achievements ko pakad kar nayi identity bana leta hai. Pehle kehta tha “main successful hoon”, ab kehta hai “main aware hoon.” Pehle kehta tha “main doosron se better hoon”, ab kehta hai “main doosron se zyada spiritual hoon.” Words badal gaye, andar “main” ki grip wahi reh sakti hai.

Sadhana ka purpose identity ko halka karna hai. Lekin savdhani na ho to sadhana bhi nayi identity ban sakti hai. Sadhak dhyan karta hai, shanti milti hai - sundar hai. Granth padhta hai, samajh badhti hai - useful hai. Seva karta hai, hriday komal hota hai - shubh hai. Lekin ahankar aa sakta hai: “main regular dhyan karta hoon, isliye main better hoon”, “mujhe gehre experiences hue hain”, “main ab normal logon jaisa nahi hoon.” Yahan sadhana identity ban gayi.

Spiritual path par experiences aate hain. Kabhi dhyan me shanti, kabhi sharir halka, kabhi vichar kam, kabhi anand. Inhe deny nahi karna. Lekin pakadna bhi nahi. Anubhavkarta keh sakta hai: “mujhe sakshi ka experience hua”, “mujhe advaita experience hua”, “ab mujhe samajh aa gaya.” Jo experience aaya aur gaya, wo experience hai. Sakshi wo hai jo us experience ko bhi jaanta hai. Experiences ka samman karo, par unhe final truth mat banao.

Spiritual ahankar ka ek subtle roop hai vinamrata ka ahankar. Sadhak kehta hai: “main to kuch bhi nahi hoon”, par andar chahta hai log kahe: “dekho, kitne vinamr hain.” Kehta hai: “mujhe samman nahi chahiye”, par samman na mile to chot lagti hai. Vinamrata sundar hai. Vinamr dikhne ki ichchha ahankar hai. Seva sundar hai. Seva se identity banana ahankar hai. Shanti sundar hai. Peaceful person ki image banana ahankar hai.

Ahankar gyaan ko bhi pakad sakta hai. Sadhak ne words samjhe - sakshi, atma, brahm, maya, ahankar, avidya, moksha. Samajh badhi. Ye achcha hai. Lekin mann keh sakta hai: “main jaanta hoon”, “doosre nahi jaante”, “meri vyakhya shreshth hai”, “mujhe koi sikhane ki zaroorat nahi.” Ye gyaan nahi, gyaan ka ahankar hai. Sacha gyaan vyakti ko zyada open banata hai, closed nahi; zyada komal, hard nahi; zyada sunne yogya, sirf bolne wala nahi.

Sabse subtle layer ho sakti hai - “main jag gaya hoon.” Sachchi jagrukta me “main” ki pakad dhili hoti hai. Par spiritual ahankar jagrukta ko bhi achievement bana sakta hai. Kehta hai: “main awake hoon, baaki soye hue hain.” Yahan purana bhed aa gaya - main upar, doosre neeche. Sadhak ko poochhna hoga: meri samajh se karuna badhi hai ya superiority? Main simple hua hoon ya special?

Seva aur tyag bhi spiritual life ke sundar parts hain. Lekin ahankar inhe bhi pakad sakta hai. Koi seva kare aur andar bhav ho: “mere bina ye nahi ho sakta”, to ahankar aa gaya. Koi tyag kare aur andar bhav ho: “dekho, main kitna tyagi hoon”, to tyag identity ban gaya. Seva rokni nahi hai. Tyag ko reject nahi karna hai. Bas unke andar chhupe “main” ko dekhna hai.

Jab sadhak apne andar spiritual ahankar dekhta hai, kabhi shame aati hai. Sochta hai: “main sadhana kar raha tha, phir bhi ahankar hai, main jhootha hoon.” Dhyan do: spiritual ahankar dikhna failure nahi hai. Wo chhupa rahe, ye zyada dangerous hai. Agar tum dekh pa rahe ho ki spiritual dikhne ki ichchha hai, to ye dekhna hi sakshi-bhav hai. Shame me mat dubo. Blame me mat jao. Bas dekho.

Spiritual ahankar ke vipreet hai sachchi saralta. Saralta ka matlab weakness nahi hai. Iska matlab hai - samajh hai par dikhawa nahi, clarity hai par hardness nahi, experience hai par pakad nahi, seva hai par claim nahi, gyaan hai par superiority nahi. Sacha sadhak jaanta hai ki jo bhi samajh aayi hai, wo kripa hai. Wo bolta hai, par sun bhi sakta hai. Wo path par chalta hai, par doosron ko chhota nahi maanta.

Jab bhi sadhana, gyaan ya experience se judi baat uthe, teen sawal poochho: kya main isse identity bana raha hoon? Kya isme superior hone ka bhav hai? Kya isme recognition, respect ya special dikhne ki ichchha hai? Agar haan aaye, chinta mat karo. Yehi dekhna hai. Phir poochho: ye ichchha kis me jaani ja rahi hai? Ye garv kis me uth raha hai? Kya sakshi isse badal raha hai?

Is khand me humne spiritual ahankar dekha. Sadhana, gyaan, experience, seva, vinamrata aur awareness tak ko ahankar pakad sakta hai. Antim khand me hum dekhenge ki ahankar se ladna nahi, use maarna nahi; use dekhna hai.

#### Aaj Ke Liye Abhyas

Aaj apni sadhana, gyaan, seva ya spiritual identity se juda ek pal dekho. Shayad tumhe laga ki tum zyada samajhte ho, apne experience par garv hua, tumne chaha ki tumhari vinamrata dekhi jaye, ya andar kisi ko “agyani” mana. Poochho: yahan sach ki saralta thi ya special hone ki ichchha? Yahan karuna thi ya superiority? Kya main is spiritual “main” ko bhi dekh sakta hoon? Dekhna hi shuddhi ki shuruaat hai.

### Chaturth Khand - Ahankar Ko Maarna Nahi, Dekhna Hai

Pichhle khand me humne spiritual ahankar ki subtle parat dekhi. Ab ek zaroori baat samajhni hai: ahankar se ladna nahi hai. Ahankar ko maarna nahi hai. Ahankar ko sakshi-bhav me dekhna hai.

Jis ahankar se tum ladoge, wo ladne wale “main” ke roop me phir khada ho jayega. Wo kahega: “main ahankar ko jeet raha hoon”, “main ahankar se mukt ho raha hoon”, “main ab doosron se zyada ego-less hoon.” Aur dekho, ahankar wapas aa gaya. Isliye raasta war ka nahi, seeing ka hai.

Jab sadhak pehli baar apne andar ahankar dekhta hai to ghabra sakta hai: “itni paratein hain, main aage kaise badhunga?” Phir mann decide karta hai: “mujhe ego destroy karna hai.” Savdhani chahiye. Agar ego destroy karne ki ichchha bhi ek hard “main” se uth rahi hai, to wo bhi ahankar ban sakti hai. Sadhana me honesty hai, violence nahi. Clarity hai, self-punishment nahi.

Ahankar ko dekhna simple hai. Jab andar koi kahe “mujhe samman chahiye”, use dekho. Jab kahe “main sahi hoon, doosra galat hai”, use dekho. Jab kahe “meri image bachni chahiye”, use dekho. Jab kahe “main bahut spiritual hoon”, use bhi dekho. Dekhna ka matlab turant fix karna nahi. Dekhna ka matlab bas itna: “ye ‘main’ ki ek parat uth rahi hai. Ye jaani ja rahi hai.”

Life me ek practical “main” zaroori rahega. Koi naam puchega, tum jawab doge. Koi kaam karna hoga, kahoge “main karunga.” Sharir ko bhojan chahiye, kahoge “mujhe bhookh hai.” Is practical “main” me problem nahi. Problem tab hoti hai jab practical “main” final truth ban jata hai. Vyavahar me “main” bolo, par andar jaano ki ye role aur function ki bhasha hai.

Ahankar ki paratein ek din me nahi bani; ek din me dhili bhi nahi hongi. Sharir se pehchan bachpan se bani. Naam aur role society ne diye. Image doosron ki nazar se bani. Story memory se bani. Spiritual identity path me bhi ban sakti hai. Inhe dhairya se dekhna hoga. Ahankar ki paratein teen baaton se dhili hoti hain: pehchanna, sweekar karna, aur sakshi-bhav me lautna.

Ek mirror ka example lo. Darpan par dhool jam gayi hai. Reflection clear nahi dikh raha. Agar koi kahe darpan kharab hai, baat poori nahi. Darpan reflect kar sakta hai; dhool upar jam gayi hai. Dhool se ladna nahi, darpan todna nahi. Dhool ko dekhna hai, dheere saaf karna hai. Ahankar ki paratein dhool jaisi hain. Wo mool satya ko cover kar sakti hain, destroy nahi kar sakti.

Jab ahankar ki pakad dhili hoti hai, rishte badalne lagte hain. Pehle chot jaldi lagti thi; ab chot uthti hai par dekhi ja sakti hai. Pehle disagreement apmaan lagta tha; ab suna ja sakta hai. Pehle prem me pakad thi; ab prem me thodi jagah aati hai. Ahankar rishte ko apni security ka tool banana chahta hai. Sakshi-bhav rishte ko zyada sachcha banata hai.

Kaam me bhi ahankar dhila ho to karm clear hota hai. Pehle kaam result se identity banata tha. Ab kaam learning aur seva ka field ban sakta hai. Pehle success se “main bada” hota tha. Ab success gratitude la sakti hai. Pehle failure se “main chhota” hota tha. Ab failure learning ka gate ban sakti hai. Identity halki hoti hai to karm weak nahi hota; karm clean hota hai.

Sadhana me ahankar sabse subtle ho sakta hai. Dhyan me shanti aaye, use jaano. Shanti na aaye, use bhi jaano. Deep experience aaye, jaano. Experience na aaye, jaano. Garv uthe: “main achcha sadhak hoon”, use jaano. Heenata uthe: “main sadhana nahi kar pa raha”, use bhi jaano. Sadhana ka goal experiences collect karna nahi hai. Goal hai har experience ke beech apne ko jaana.

Ab is adhyay ki yatra sametein. Pratham khand me humne mool gaanth dekhi - “main sharir-mann hoon.” Dwitiya khand me role, image aur story ka ahankar dekha. Tritiya khand me spiritual ahankar dekha. Is antim khand me dekha ki ahankar se ladna nahi, use maarna nahi; use sakshi-bhav me dekhna hai. Jo clearly dekha jata hai, uski pakad dheere-dheere dhili hoti hai.

Ab sadhak agle kadam ke liye taiyar hai. Ab tak dekha: main sirf sharir nahi, sirf mann nahi, sirf anubhavkarta nahi, sirf role, image, kahani ya spiritual experience nahi. Agla adhyay hai - Neti-Neti. Neti-Neti ka saral arth hai - “ye nahi, ye nahi.” Ye negative hona nahi hai. Iska arth hai: jo main nahi hoon, use clarity se pehchanna, taki jo main hoon wo apne aap clear hone lage.

Ahankar ki paratein dekhna kabhi difficult lag sakta hai, lekin sahi bhav se dekha jaye to ye bahut halka karta hai. Har role ko final identity nahi banana. Har criticism se tootna nahi. Har praise me phoolna nahi. Har story ko pakad kar nahi baithna. Har spiritual experience ko achievement nahi banana. Bas dekhna hai. Jaise-jaise dekhna gehra hota hai, life halki hoti hai.

Jahan bhi “main” strong uthe, ruko aur dekho: ye kaunsa “main” hai? Kis se pehchan bana raha hai? Kya chahta hai? Kya ye bhi jaana ja raha hai? Isi sawal me ahankar ki pakad dhili hone lagti hai. Dheere chalo. Komal raho. Chhupao mat. Blame mat karo. Bas dekho. Dekhna hi mukti ki disha hai.

#### Is Hafte Ke Liye Abhyas

Agle saat din ahankar ki paraton ko bahut komalta se dekho. Jab bhi “main” strong uthe, poochho: abhi kaunsi parat active hai - sharir identity, mann ki rai, role, image, purani story, success-failure, ya spiritual identity? Phir poochho: is “main” ko abhi kya chahiye - samman, security, control, prem, recognition, right prove hona, ya special dikhna? Phir teesra sawal: kya main is “main” ko dekh sakta hoon? Agar dekh pa rahe ho, kaho: “ye ahankar ki parat uth rahi hai. Ye jaani ja rahi hai. Main ise dekh sakta hoon.” Ise self-blame mat banao. Ise inner cleaning ka komal abhyas banao.
